column1: # Reference alleles for every variant used by a committed example, pinned
# against hg38 so a wrong coordinate cannot ship silently again (#128).
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# A BCL11A example carried ref="G" where hg38 has T and shipped for months. The
# "does not match the genome" warning fired on every single run and nobody read
# it, because it always fired. Chorus now raises instead (strict_ref, default
# True), and this table is the offline half: it catches a bad coordinate at test
# time rather than at scoring time.
# Verified 2026-08-02 against genomes/hg38.fa. All four are currently correct —
# BCL11A was fixed earlier; it is pinned here so it cannot regress.
# NOT LISTED, deliberately: region_swap and integration_simulation record
# ref_allele="wt" in their report JSON. That is a display sentinel, not a
# nucleotide — both go through predict_region_replacement, never the ref-allele
# check, so there is nothing to pin. See chorus/analysis/region_swap.py:70 and
# chorus/analysis/integration.py:66.
